name: node-nest
description: A self-operated NestJS API server — NestJS 11 + PostgreSQL + TypeORM 1 + class-validator. Modules, DI, and decorators set the structure.

notes.securityBoundary: The application layer is the only boundary — the DB is reached over a trusted connection, so nothing leans on row-level policy. A missing ownership check is a data leak, and this axis's own trap is that TypeORM's `where` **means OR when it is an array**: in a query with two branches, such as cursor pagination, dropping the ownership filter on one branch lets that branch through to other people's rows. The authentication method (self-issued JWT · session · external IdP) is undecided, so it is a question to confirm
notes.serverCodeLocation: The API server in this repository. Even when the frontend axis has a server runtime (Next.js, etc.), API ownership sits here — the guide pins the boundary of which of the two holds the logic first
notes.toolchain: The language and package manager are often the same as the frontend's, so monorepos are common. Nest finds injection targets through decorator metadata, so `experimentalDecorators` and `emitDecoratorMetadata` must be on; turn them off and **it compiles but dies at boot**
notes.variants: The framework (NestJS) and ORM (TypeORM) are pinned into the pack. Pick Express and backend/node-api owns that shape; pick Drizzle and backend/aws-container does — a different combination gives you not nothing but **the wrong thing**
